info.title: Bean Bloom Coffee — Agent API
info.description: Small-batch roasted coffee beans, shipped from Yunnan. Agent-first storefront at https://agent-friendly-platform.refined-x.workers.dev/shops/bean-bloom/ Paths in this document are absolute from the host root, e.g. /shops/bean-bloom/llms.txt.

200.description: Full shop corpus: products and policies
Product list with price and stock

post.description: Live endpoint: POST https://agent-friendly-platform.refined-x.workers.dev/shops/bean-bloom/mcp, Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18, tools: list_products, get_product, recommend_products, calculate_total, create_order, submit_payment_proof, confirm_payment, get_order, mark_shipped, confirm_receipt, cancel_order, update_buyer_info, get_payment_proof_upload_link. Catalog and orders are served from D1 on this Worker. See mcp.json.

200.description: Shopping-assistant guide: conversation flow, questions, recommendations
Structured recommendations, bundles and free-shipping tips
Canonical presentation IR: products, options, actions, totals, Markdown fallback, per-client adapters
Offline payment methods, flow, and proof submission

get.description: Order status timeline (order_events) for one order. Public read; the order id is the credential.

200.description: Order id, current status and the event timeline

get.description: Seller admin web UI (human seller only, API-key login). Not for buyers' agents; not listed in llms.txt / agent.json.
Seller admin: list orders (filter by status). Requires the shop admin key (Bearer) or session cookie.

200.description: Order counts by status + order list

post.description: Seller admin: confirm receipt of an offline payment (same logic as the confirm_payment MCP tool). verified_amount_cny must equal the order total.
Seller admin: mark a paid order shipped (carrier + tracking_number optional).
